title: Deploy
lede: Three environments, same files. Edit locally with live reload, push a branch to get a shareable preview link, merge to main to update the link everyone bookmarks.

items.title: 1 · Local
items.text: Your laptop. `npm run dev` → http://localhost:4321. Save a module file and the page updates in about two seconds. Nothing leaves your machine.

items.title: 2 · Preview
items.text: Any branch you push gets its own Vercel URL. Share it in Discord for review. Team-only by default.

items.title: 3 · Production
items.text: The `main` branch. The HQ link pinned in Discord. Updates on every merge.

items.lines:
# Run it locally
cd hopamine/hq
npm run dev                 # opens on http://localhost:4321
# no Node? use:
python3 -m http.server 4321

# Before pushing
npm run check               # validates every module

items.title: Ask Claude Code
items.text: Open HOPAMINE/hopamine in the Claude app's Code tab (HQ lives in `hq/`) and say what changed: "mark S1·2 done and set Sprint 1 progress to 40%".

items.title: It opens a branch
items.text: Claude edits the module JSON, runs the check, and pushes a branch.

items.title: Preview link
items.text: Vercel posts a preview URL. Open it on LTE, share it with the dev leads.

items.title: Merge
items.text: Happy? Merge the PR. Production updates in under a minute.

blocks.title: Vercel setup
rows: Root Directory `hq`, same repo as the product, its own deploy and link
HQ sits next to the code it describes; the product build ignores it
Ignored build step: only rebuild when `hq/` changes
Internal only. For someone outside the Vercel team, use **Share** on a deployment to send a temporary link
5 projects build the demo repo today
`zima`, `zima.beta`, `zima-beta`, `zima-build`, `zima-k3qv` all redeploy on every push. Keep one.
